value.signature: fn on_record (& self , id : & Id , values : & Record < '_ > , context : Context < '_ , S >)

exception.justification: Justified: This observation or protected-carrier primitive executes inside the explicit operation and delivery machinery; instrumenting it recursively would make observation observe itself.

review.body: { let Some (_observing) = Observing :: enter (& self . 0) else { return ; } ; if let Some (span) = context . span (id) && let Some (account) = span . extensions_mut () . get_mut :: < SpanAccount > () && self . 0 . full_trace { values . record (& mut account . fields) ; } }
review.item_premise: Public values remain structured through the queue, with bounded byte charge and loss causes. Artifact chunks bound JSON nesting. Exit reports delivered, lost and undelivered records synchronously after its byte-scaled drain deadline. These delivery changes do not affect results or secret exposure.
